label.name: Name
label.selectConfig: Select or add a Datacake account first
label.moreDevices: __shown__ of __total__ devices shown, refine the search

tip.inMessage: Every message carries msg.payload, msg.deviceId, msg.fieldName and more details in msg.datacake.
tip.outDynamic: Messages coming straight from a datacake in node are never written back to the device and field they came from, to prevent endless loops.
tip.outPayload: Send an object such as {"TEMPERATURE": 21.5, "HUMIDITY": 48}. Each field is published as its own message.

errors.noConfig: No Datacake account is configured for this node
errors.noToken: The Datacake account has no API token
errors.noConfigOrToken: No Datacake account or API token configured
errors.msgDeviceId: msg.deviceId must contain the id of a Datacake device
errors.msgFieldName: msg.fieldName must contain a field identifier such as TEMPERATURE
errors.unknownProduct: Cannot determine the product of device __deviceId__, set msg.productSlug
errors.unknownField: Field __field__ does not exist on this device and was not sent
errors.loop: Field __field__ was not written back to the device it was read from (loop protection)
